API Reference for the Edge Runtime.
content: The Edge Runtime does not support all Node.js APIs. Some packages may not work as expected.The Edge Runtime does not support Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).Both runtimes can support streaming depending on your deployment adapter.

documentDescription: API Reference for the Edge Runtime.
content:
The Edge Runtime has some restrictions including:

Native Node.js APIs are not supported. For example, you can't read or write to the filesystem.node_modules can be used, as long as they implement ES Modules and do not use native Node.js APIs.Calling require directly is not allowed. Use ES Modules instead.

The following JavaScript language features are disabled, and will not work:

| API                                                                                                                             | Description                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| eval                                       | Evaluates JavaScript code represented as a string                   |
